Read several ride files into one long tibble

Source: R/read_rides.R
read_rides.Rd

The unit of analysis is a run (one session, ridden once) recorded by two or more sources (power meters). This assembles that structure explicitly, so the run and source labels come from a spec you can read.

Usage

read_rides(spec)

Arguments

spec

Data frame with columns path, run and source, or the path to a directory of .fit, .gpx or .csv files named <run>_<source>.

Value

A tibble on the canonical ride schema with run and source prepended.

Details

A directory is accepted as well as a spec, since a folder of files is what you usually have. The filenames are then read by ride_spec_from_names(), which needs them to be <run>_<source>; build the spec yourself where they are not.

See also

Other reading: read_file(), ride_spec_from_names()

Examples

rides <- read_rides(demo_rides())
head(rides)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 4
#>   run   source  time                power
#>   <chr> <chr>   <dttm>              <dbl>
#> 1 run1  assioma 2026-03-14 09:00:00  234.
#> 2 run1  assioma 2026-03-14 09:00:01  227.
#> 3 run1  assioma 2026-03-14 09:00:02  243.
#> 4 run1  assioma 2026-03-14 09:00:03  220.
#> 5 run1  assioma 2026-03-14 09:00:04  248.
#> 6 run1  assioma 2026-03-14 09:00:05  251.
